post_title: What will Statistics Poland's flash estimate of Poland's Q3 2026 GDP growth be?

question.title: What will Statistics Poland's flash estimate of Poland's Q3 2026 GDP growth be?
question.description:
Poland's GDP grew 3.8% in real terms in 2025. In its 16 October 2026 release, GUS revised its quarterly national accounts: quarterly dynamics for 2025 and the first half of 2026 were revised upward by around 0.2 percentage points, putting Q1 2026 at 3.7% y/y and Q2 2026 at 4.1% y/y. Third-quarter monthly data were mixed: industrial production rose 4.6% y/y in September (after 4.0% in August) and beat the 3.1% consensus, construction-assembly output fell around 9% y/y in September against a +2.4% expectation, and retail sales slowed to +3.3% y/y (from +6.4% a year earlier). Registered unemployment was 5.8% in September, the average enterprise wage PLN 9,266, GUS's October flash CPI 3.5% y/y, the general business climate indicator -6.6 and the consumer confidence indicator -14.0. Bank economists' Q3 nowcasts published in late October clustered around 3.6-3.9% y/y (mBank roughly 3.6-3.8%, Pekao roughly 3.8-3.9%) — a slowdown from Q2. GUS publishes a flash ("szybki") quarterly GDP estimate about 45 days after quarter-end (13 August 2026 for Q2 2026, 14 May 2026 for Q1 2026), followed by a preliminary ("wstępny") estimate at the end of the following month; the flash release carries only the headline year-on-year rate plus a short comment, and revisions of 0.1-0.3pp to flash figures are common. The Q3 2026 figure has not yet been published.

question.resolution_criteria: This question resolves to the year-on-year real growth rate of Poland's gross domestic product in the third quarter of 2026, seasonally unadjusted and at constant prices, as first published by Statistics Poland (GUS) in its flash estimate ("Szybki szacunek produktu krajowego brutto za 3 kwartał 2026 r."), which is listed on GUS's release calendar at https://stat.gov.pl/en/release-calendar and is due in mid-November 2026. For example, if GUS states that GDP "in volume terms seasonally unadjusted was higher by 3.4% in the 3rd quarter of 2026 year-on-year", the question resolves to 3.4. Only this flash estimate counts: the later preliminary ("wstępny") estimate, the full quarterly national accounts and any subsequent revisions do not change the answer. If the figure cannot be retrieved from GUS's website, [credible sources](https://www.metaculus.com/faq/#definitions) reporting the GUS flash estimate will be used.
question.fine_print: If GUS's flash release contains more than one year-on-year GDP growth rate, the seasonally unadjusted ("niewyrównany sezonowo") figure is the one used.
